indicator.name: Key crop production (county-dominant crop only)
indicator.description: Production of the county-dominant crop where a comparable official table exists.
indicator.expected_source: KNBS / Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development — National Agriculture Production Report 2024, Annex 1
indicator.expected_availability_note: Retired/replaced in P21. Use IND-MAIZE-AREA, IND-MAIZE-PRODUCTION, IND-MAIZE-YIELD: fixed-definition county maize measures already published 47/47 from the official 2023 Annex 1 table. The former dominant-crop concept mixed different crops/units and was not retained as a comparable indicator.
